scope: sandbox runtime source excluding __tests__ fixtures, synthetic fixture source, generated .next-sandbox bundle, and task-01 evidence metadata
scanCommand: PowerShell aggregate scan: npm run verify-artifact --workspace @agentoma/experiment-sandbox plus rg -n -P secret, PHI, fixture, bundle, log-field, runtime-URL, and browser-storage patterns; runtime counts exclude apps/experiment-sandbox/src/**/__tests__/** because those tests intentionally contain forbidden-pattern literals and safe preview fixtures

results.name: secret-scan
results.summary: Runtime sandbox source contains no private-key material, provider key, connection string, or token-shaped value.

results.name: phi-identifier-scan
results.summary: Synthetic fixture source contains no health-number, demographic, medication, prescription, or patient-identifier fields.

results.name: fixture-shape-scan
results.summary: Synthetic fixture corpus contains no plausible identifier, contact, or credential-shaped value.

results.name: bundle-scan
results.summary: Generated sandbox bundle files contain no credential, token, connection string, or PHI identifier.

results.name: log-evidence-scan
results.summary: Evidence JSON contains metadata and hashes only; no sensitive payload field is present.

results.name: runtime-url-scan
results.summary: Non-test runtime source contains no URL outside the approved loopback sandbox origin.

results.name: storage-scan
results.summary: Non-test runtime sandbox source contains no browser persistence, cache, service-worker, or beacon API.
